description: Test suite for utility functions related to key information processing in a dashboard component, including filtering sensitive metadata, extracting logging settings, formatting metadata for display, and stripping tags.

methods.name: filterSensitiveMetadata
methods.description: Removes sensitive top-level fields like 'logging' from metadata objects.

methods.name: extractLoggingSettings
methods.description: Extracts the logging array from metadata, returning the same reference if present.

methods.name: formatMetadataForDisplay
methods.description: Stringifies metadata for display, omitting sensitive fields such as 'logging'.

methods.name: stripTagsFromMetadata
methods.description: Removes 'tags' property from metadata without mutating the original object.
